## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses associated with physical or virtual infrastructure components, such as servers, networks, storage, or cloud resources.
page_texts.3:
[rcas/infrastructure/README.md#examples-of-infrastructure-rcas]

## Examples of Infrastructure RCAs

- Network outages due to router misconfiguration
- Server failures caused by hardware issues or capacity constraints
- Cloud service disruptions (e.g., AWS EC2 instance failure)
- Storage system failures or performance degradation
- Database server crashes or connectivity issues
- Load balancer failures affecting service availability
- DNS resolution problems causing widespread outages
